title: Calculation Sheet — Amount of a Card-on-File Charge, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Clause.** For the card-on-file charge on the Patient Financial Account, the most recent encounter is the encounter of the deductible or coinsurance line posted last on the account, and the encounter's lines are its deductible and coinsurance lines. The card-on-file charge covers the encounter's lines whose card-on-file notice has run — that is, lines posted at least the tier's card-on-file advance-notice days, in calendar days, before the handling date — counted in full, less every payment, time-of-service collection and adjustment already applied to the encounter. The card-on-file charge is capped at the tier's maximum automatic charge per encounter, the whole capped amount (100 percent of it) is charged, the charge is never below 0.00, and it is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## The quantities, in order

1. **Most recent encounter** — the encounter of whichever deductible or coinsurance line was posted last on the account.
2. **Covered lines** — the total of that encounter's deductible and coinsurance lines whose posting date is at least the tier's advance-notice days before the handling date; a line posted more recently is not covered.
3. **Chargeable amount** — the covered lines less every payment, time-of-service collection and adjustment already applied to the encounter.
4. **Capped amount** — the lower of the chargeable amount and the tier's maximum automatic charge per encounter.
5. **Card-on-file charge** — the whole capped amount, never below 0.00, rounded once to the nearest cent.

The advance-notice days and the maximum automatic charge are the figures of the account's financial class in the card-on-file terms.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

Tier figures assumed for the illustration: advance notice 5 calendar days, maximum automatic charge 750.00. The most recent encounter has a deductible line of 420.00 posted 10 days before the handling date and a coinsurance line of 180.00 posted 3 days before it; 50.00 has already been collected against the encounter.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| deductible line: posted 10 days ago, 10 is at least 5 | covered, 420.00 |
| coinsurance line: posted 3 days ago, 3 is fewer than 5 | not covered |
| covered lines | 420.00 |
| less amounts already applied to the encounter | 420.00 less 50.00 gives 370.00 |
| cap of 750.00 | 370.00 is lower, so 370.00 |
| whole capped amount charged | 370.00 |

A second hypothetical: had both lines been posted 12 days before the handling date and nothing been applied, the covered lines would total 600.00, below the 750.00 cap, and the charge would be 600.00; with lines totalling 900.00 the cap would bring the charge to 750.00.
